status: P6-WP3 API CONTRACT APPROVED FOLLOWING INDEPENDENT REVIEW — REMOTE CI + MERGE PENDING
authority_note: Machine-readable source for P6-WP4 OpenAPI. Not OpenAPI, not an implementation, not runtime authority. API-001 is the normative human-readable contract. Hand edits must pass the JSON Schema, validate_api_contract.py (including negative mutations), the CI self-test and the canonical gate.

tenancy.note: Single provisional deployment scope; no tenant field anywhere. Re-review required before implementation if multi-tenancy is confirmed.

conventions.identifiers: opaque UUIDv4 (canonical lowercase text); knowledge identifiers (rule_id, content_digest) are governed and separate
conventions.pagination: opaque cursor; limit bounded by implementation configuration (NOT YET SPECIFIED)

api_upload_state.note: Collapses internal cross-store states; FINALIZED is reported only when bytes are durably stored and digest-verified.

api_evaluation_state.note: RESULT_COMPUTED_PERSISTENCE_PENDING is reported as RUNNING: completion is never shown before durable persistence.

api_result_availability.note: AVAILABLE only for COMPLETED evaluations whose stored result exists; REMOVED_UNDER_GOVERNANCE marks a historical COMPLETED tombstone (P6-WP6/OI-05 own final semantics); NOT_PRODUCED for failed evaluations.

api_report_state.note: GENERATING is served from the REPORT_GENERATE cross-store operation before the report record's outcome exists.

api_replay_state.note: COMPLETED replays carry capability + outcome; unavailable material is an explicit outcome, never an error or success.

analysis_mode.note: AI_ASSISTED_IF_ENABLED is honoured only when deployment policy enables Phase-4 extraction; otherwise deterministic with fallback AI_DISABLED.

ApiErrorBody.description: Error body; never contains stack traces, SQL, internal paths, credentials, tokens or evidence.

FieldError.description: Per-field validation error (field path only; never echoes submitted values).

ReasonCommandRequest.description: Command carrying a categorical reason and optional bounded note (no evidence content).

MeResponse.description: Authenticated principal summary; never contains tokens or credentials.

HealthProbeResponse.description: Minimal liveness/readiness body; no dependency or topology detail.

OperationalHealthResponse.description: Categorical operator health; no hostnames, versions of infrastructure or topology.

CaseCreateRequest.description: Creates an empty case. Owner is the authenticated principal; no evidence required.

CaseResponse.description: Case resource. No verdict field: decisions exist only on evaluations.

CaseViewerAccess.description: The caller's own access, computed server-side.

SubmissionCreateRequest.description: Categorical submission metadata only. Content (including free-text user context) is submitted through the evidence boundary.

EvidenceUploadCreateRequest.description: Initiates an evidence item. All values are untrusted declarations; the server computes the authoritative SHA-256.

EvidenceContentUpload.description: Raw bytes of the evidence item (request body is the content; Content-Type = declared media type).

EvidenceFinalizeRequest.description: Requests server-side durable verification and manifest finalization.

EvidenceMetadataResponse.description: Evidence metadata only — never content bytes, never the internal storage locator.

EvidenceContentDownload.description: Exact original bytes; Content-Type = verified media type; Content-Disposition: attachment with a server-generated filename; Cache-Control: no-store.

EvaluationCreateRequest.description: Requests deterministic evaluation of the submission's finalized evidence. Cannot carry any decision, provenance or knowledge field.

EvaluationBatchAcceptedResponse.description: One evaluation per governed input envelope derived from the submission (exactly one for MVP text submissions).

EvaluationFailure.description: Safe categorical failure; never a classification; never internal detail.

AiUsageSummary.description: Governed AI provenance only: no AI verdict, no model confidence.

DetectionResultResponse.description: Exact Phase-3 decision axes (categorical; no probability or score). NO_SCAM_PATTERN means no governed pattern matched, never 'safe'.

RuleReference.description: Governed knowledge reference (not an operational ID).

RecommendedActionView.description: Governed action from the Phase-3 action policy. No priority: Phase 3 does not emit one (WP6), and the API never invents one.

UserCorrectionCreateRequest.description: User extraction correction; creates a new evaluation.

EnrichmentView.description: Normalized, non-authoritative advisory metadata; no provider credentials, raw provider bodies, ECS locators or network targets. reputation_result CLEAN is a provider assertion only, never TrustLens safe (advisory = true).

AdjudicationCreateRequest.description: New adjudication record; actor and time are server-side.

ReviewAssignmentRequest.description: Assigns an analyst (creates an ASSIGNED_ANALYST case grant).

ReportCreateRequest.description: Generates a new report revision or reproduces an existing one from its pins.

ReportContentDownload.description: Report bytes (format owned by Phase 7 / REPORT-001); Cache-Control: no-store.

ReplayCreateRequest.description: Historical deterministic replay of exactly the pinned material. No mode, knowledge, AI or profile selection is accepted.

ReplayResponse.description: Replay verification record; never a new result.

KnowledgeActiveResponse.description: Active exact bundle identity for this deployment.

KnowledgeBundleResponse.description: Bundle reference metadata; no rule bodies.

KnowledgeActivationRequest.description: Activate an exact published bundle by content_digest.

KnowledgeRollbackRequest.description: Explicit rollback to an exact previously validated bundle (never 'previous').

KnowledgeWithdrawalRequest.description: Records the governed (Git/CI) withdrawal of the exact bundle in the path for this deployment.

DeletionRequestCreateRequest.description: Governed deletion request; never immediate destruction.

BreakGlassReviewRequest.description: Mandatory post-event review by a different principal.

operations.notes: v1: ADMINISTRATOR is the only creator/activator (an ANALYST cannot self-elevate). Reason required; server-set short expiry (duration NOT YET SPECIFIED); always audited and signalled; mandatory review by a different principal. Analyst request/approval is a possible future, separately reviewed workflow.

P6-WP6 additive: one AUDIT_LOG_ACCESSED accountability event per authorized audit-read operation (actor, time, correlation, scope/filter category); returned audit-event bodies are never copied into it and reading AUDIT_LOG_ACCESSED events does not recursively audit each row (OPS-001 §8).
